topic: Is 3.4-3.8 GHz 5G safe for radio altimeters in Europe?

positions.view: Margins >= 6 dB in modelled ILS scenario; no interference in tests
Report does not justify fleet-wide retrofit; case-by-case
Cannot conclude no interference for all cases; not representative of all altimeters

handling: Retain all; arbitration should weight by jurisdiction and cite uncertainty

topic: Is India's DGCA measure a retrofit mandate or flight-manual limitation?

positions.view: Limitations apply to non-tolerant aircraft from 2027-12-31; tolerant aircraft need no action

handling: Prefer tier-1 text; effect is functionally similar

topic: Does 500+ MHz separation make India's C-band safe?

positions.view: No risk; 3300-3670 MHz is far below 4200 MHz
RAs cannot be relied on under 3.3-3.67 GHz interference

handling: Regulator's finding governs aviation ops; separation informs simulator priors only

topic: Minimum separation distance for safety case
handling: Expose as parameter range in simulator; do not hard-code one value

topic: Does the ITM need to extend above 500 ft AGL?

positions.view: No; 450 ft BS cap + path loss

handling: Airspace agent should flag residual risk above 500 ft for non-listed scenarios
